items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: But I remember Thomas, Freddie, Albert and Hassel.

ctx.x: Harrison. Well, Harrison had three girls of himself. Yeah. One was called Fetty Bones and Alpha Bones. Yeah. One was playing baritone and one was playing planet. Fetty was playing baritone and Alpha was playing planet. and Alpha was playing Planet and Hassel was playing trumpet. Then he had another brother call him, oh he used to be the leader of that band, another brother, I can't think of his
name. Thomas Smallman. He had four brothers playing that band. Thomas, Thomas Bones.
That was the oldest brother, Thomas Bones. Well he had four brothers playing music. But I remember Thomas, Freddie, Albert and Hassel. Hassel was the youngest one. The youngest.
